newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Lydex shares leap after Harmony deal.
newsitem.headline: Lydex shares leap after Harmony deal.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Lyndenburg Exploration Ltd jumped more than 50 percent on Friday as trading in its stock resumed following the purchase of a 44.8 percent stake by Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd.
Lydex shares rose from 870 cents before the deal to a high of 13.50 rand when their suspension was lifted on Tuesday. By 0958 GMT the price had slipped back to 13.10 rand.
The 89.5 million rand purchase price comprises a cash payment of 10 rand per share for the 6.4 million Lydex shares held by Old Mutual plus 45 Harmony options for every 100 Lydex shares held.
The total purchase price equates to 14 rand per Lydex share.
"There is a fair demand for the stock and it is a good price," said one dealer.

Harmony said it made the buy in order to extend its operation beyond its mine's current lease boundaries and accelerate Harmony's development from a gold producer into a more broadly based and gold mining and exploration company.
